description.en: A calm dinosaur valley story with gentle dinosaurs, leaves, eggs, and quiet fossils.
description.zh-Hans: 一个安静的恐龙山谷故事，认识温柔的恐龙、叶子、恐龙蛋和化石。

plotPlan.mainCharacter: A smiling baby dinosaur in a calm green valley.
plotPlan.setting: A sunny prehistoric valley with soft hills, rounded rocks, ferns, and a quiet pond.
plotPlan.goal: The baby dinosaur gently explores the valley and meets friendly dinosaur words.
plotPlan.beginning: The baby dinosaur smiles in the safe green valley.
plotPlan.middle: The baby dinosaur notices a long-neck dinosaur, a triceratops, a stegosaurus, footprints, leaves, and fossils.
plotPlan.ending: A pteranodon floats above the quiet valley while the nest and egg rest calmly below.
plotPlan.emotionalTone: Calm, curious, friendly, slow, and toddler-safe.
learningGoals: Hear each important word in English and Simplified Chinese.
Practice tapping visible story items to repeat audio.
Explore dinosaurs without danger, chasing, scoring, or failure states.
interactionIdeas: Tap a dinosaur to hear its word and make it bounce softly.
Tap the fern or pteranodon to float gently.
Tap the nest, egg, footprint, or fossil to glow softly.
Tap the scene text to replay calm narration.

coverImage.alt: Friendly dinosaurs smile together in a calm sunny dinosaur valley

text.en: The baby dinosaur smiles at the gentle valley.
text.zh-Hans: 恐龙宝宝对温柔的山谷微笑。
